# Quovex — AI Student Operating System
> The AI-powered study ecosystem for serious students worldwide.

## Brand & Product Identity
- Name: Quovex
- Platforms: Android Native App, Web Platform (https://quovex.online)
- Founders: Rohit & Kartikey (Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India)
- Studio: Refind Global Studio
- Core Purpose: Consolidates Focus Timer, Quovex AI Tutor, SM-2 Flashcards, NCERT Library, and Virtual Study Rooms into one synchronized workspace.
